forecast.decision_consequence: Signal-only. This is the BENCHMARK arm of the CLO AAA canary that LIQ-03's letter did not separate (KB-LIQ-065): whether senior BSL paper repriced, as distinct from the MM/PC tail which already did. It authorizes no trade and moves no gate. The 0.25 is the forecast as registered on 2026-07-01 and is deliberately submitted unchanged rather than re-marked at submission time; current tape corroborates rather than contradicts it, since the 2026-08-26 within-AAA pattern still shows stress concentrated in the tail while the senior benchmark stays calm.

question.ambiguity_rule: ⚠️ This question resolves against trade-press and filing evidence, NOT a deterministic machine-readable series; the PitchBook LCD monthly-average series named in the originating prediction is subscription-gated and its reachability from the operating environment was never established at registration (access check owed since 2026-08-20, performed 2026-08-27, result: not retrievable as a series). That is disclosed here rather than discovered at resolution. If a cited source reports a period average that is not a calendar-month average (for example quarterly or year-to-date), it does NOT satisfy the monthly-average basis and must not be substituted; use the fallback construction instead. If sources disagree on a month's average, prefer the source whose stated basis most exactly matches US BSL new-issue calendar-month AAA, and record every figure considered. If a figure's segment (BSL versus MM/PC) cannot be established from the source, it is non-qualifying and must not be counted in either direction. Do not infer a monthly average from a small number of individual prints without applying the fallback procedure and labelling the result CONSTRUCTED.
annulment_rules: Annul only if the US BSL CLO new-issue market ceases to exist or ceases primary issuance entirely for the whole measured interval, such that no monthly average exists and none can be constructed.

Annul only if all primary and fallback records needed to determine any month's average are permanently unavailable after the registered negative-search procedure, such that YES versus NO cannot be determined without inference.
Do NOT annul merely because the subscription-gated PitchBook LCD series remains unreachable; that contingency is anticipated and the fallback construction from SEC EDGAR primary filings governs.
question.claim: In at least one calendar month from 2026-07-01 through 2026-12-31 inclusive, the United States broadly-syndicated-loan (BSL) new-issue CLO AAA monthly average spread exceeds 150 basis points over term SOFR.
question.fallback_resolution_source: If no third-party monthly average is published for a month in the measured interval, construct that month's average deal-by-deal from primary SEC EDGAR filings for US BSL CLO new issues priced in that month, equal-weighting the AAA/senior-most tranche spread of each qualifying new-issue deal, and record the full deal list, each spread, and each filing accession number. A constructed average must be labelled CONSTRUCTED in the resolution record and must never be presented as a published figure.
question.negative_search_procedure: To establish a clean NO, for each of the six months July through December 2026: (1) search the PitchBook LCD public CLO article stream for that month's US BSL new-issue AAA average, recording URL, query terms, access timestamp, the figure and its stated basis; (2) check the VanEck quarterly CLO recap covering that month and the Aristotle Pacific CLOIE monitor; (3) if no qualifying published monthly average is found, run the fallback construction from SEC EDGAR, enumerating every US BSL CLO new-issue priced that month with its AAA tranche spread and accession number; (4) record explicitly, per month, whether the figure is PUBLISHED or CONSTRUCTED, its value, and whether it exceeds SOFR+150bp. A NO resolution requires all six months present with a recorded value and basis; any month left undetermined blocks NO and the resolution is reported as un-completable rather than resolved.
question.resolution_condition: Resolves YES if, for at least one calendar month M in July 2026 through December 2026 inclusive, a published monthly average new-issue spread for United States BSL CLO AAA (senior-most rated tranche) primary issuance in month M exceeds SOFR+150bp. Resolves NO if every such published monthly average for July through December 2026 is at or below SOFR+150bp. The measured interval is fixed at July-December 2026 and does NOT extend to closes_at; closes_at exists only so the December figure can publish before resolution.
question.resolution_rule: SEGMENT IS BINDING AND EXCLUSIVE: only United States BROADLY-SYNDICATED-LOAN (BSL) CLO AAA new-issue counts. Middle-market and private-credit (MM/PC) CLO AAA is EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED and never qualifies, however wide it prints. This exclusion is the entire point of the question: its predecessor LIQ-03 resolved ACHIEVED at the letter on MM/PC tail prints (Diameter senior AAA S+170 on 2026-04-24, A-2 S+185) while the BSL benchmark never exceeded roughly S+125 average in the same stress, a within-AAA bifurcation of more than 60bp registered as KB-LIQ-065. BASIS IS BINDING: the test is a MONTHLY AVERAGE of new-issue prints, never a single deal, never a wide-tier or tail print, never a secondary-market or reset/refi-only spread. A single BSL deal printing above SOFR+150 in a month whose average is at or below SOFR+150 does NOT resolve YES. Resets and refinancings are excluded unless the cited source's own monthly average includes them, in which case the source's stated basis governs and must be recorded.
